    The user has posted a complete HTML file of a tic-tac-toe game in Russian. It appears they want me to recreate/improve this as a React + Vite + Tailwind application. The game has:

    1. Tic-tac-toe (Крестики-нолики) with multiple modes:
      • Easy: 3×3 Forest theme (rabbit vs wolf emojis)
      • Medium: 6×6 Sea theme (fish vs shell)
      • Hard: 10×10 Space theme (rocket vs asteroid)
      • Classic: notebook paper style (blue X vs red O)
      • Match: "three in a row" match-3 game with western theme
    2. Game modes: AI opponent, local 2-player, online (Firebase)
    3. Profile system: nickname, score persistence (localStorage)
    4. Sound system: Web Audio API, procedural music per theme
    5. Special events: elf shooting arrows (easy), fish grabbing pieces (medium), black hole sucking pieces (hard)
    6. Auto-restart after game ends
    7. Fullscreen toggle, volume slider
    8. Online play via Firebase Realtime Database

    My task: Build this as a polished React + Vite + Tailwind app. I should aim for Awwwards-level quality. The user's message is in Russian, so they're Russian-speaking. The UI language should stay Russian.

    The event system: after each turn (except classic/match/online), chance to trigger:

    • easy: elf picks a random empty cell as elf position, shoots arrow along row/col/diag to remove an occupied piece.
    • medium: fish flies from a random empty cell to nearest occupied piece, carries it to a random empty destination.
    • hard: black hole at random empty cell sucks up to 5 nearby pieces.

    For React, I'll build an EffectsLayer with useImperativeHandle exposing runEvent(type, payload) returning a Promise. Payload includes geometry: cell rects computed from refs passed by board. Actually simpler: Board stores cell refs in a shared ref object passed down to EffectsLayer, which can query cellRefs[i].getBoundingClientRect().

Hmm — values change in place, physical pieces move between cells. To animate falling properly, pieces need stable keys that move between positions — significant complexity. Compromise: visually animate with a quick fade/scale transition per changed cell (new pieces pop in top <-> processMatches loop), and matched cells burst with a scale-out + small particle rings. Simplest: AnimatePresence keyed on value+token, entry: scale 0.3→1 spring, exit: scale→0 with blur. Good enough.

    Count-up hook:

    ts
    function useAnimatedNumber(v:number){ const [d,setD]=useState(v); const ref=useRef(v); useEffect(()=>{ const from=ref.current; const to=v; if(from===to) return; const t0=performance.now(); const dur=600; let raf:number; const step=(t)=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur); const e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3); const cur=Math.round(from+(to-from)*e); setD(cur); if(p<1) raf=requestAnimationFrame(step); else ref.current=to;}; raf=requestAnimationFrame(step); return ()=>cancelAnimationFrame(raf); },[v]); return d; }

    • 6×6 Море — пузыри, лучи света, эвристический ИИ (5 в ряд)
    • 10×10 Космос — мерцающие звёзды, падающие кометы, планета с кольцом (7 в ряд, блокировка двойных угроз)
    • Тетрадь — разлинованный лист с полями и проколотыми дырками, рукописные крестики/нолики, шрифт Caveat
    • Три в ряд — закат на Диком Западе: солнце, холмы с кактусами, ромбовидное поле 33 клетки, комбо-каскады, очки за фишки (до 50), автоперемешивание при отсутствии ходов

    Геймплей

    • Против ИИ, на одном ПК, и по сети (Firebase Realtime Database — комнаты по 5-значному коду, анонимная авторизация, автоудаление комнаты при выходе, рематч)
    • Полевые события, как в оригинале, но с иконками Lucide вместо эмодзи: лесной дух со стрелой, рыба-воровка, чёрная дыра с засасыванием фишек (с тряской доски)
    • Анимированная линия победы, прорисовываемая по реальным координатам клеток
    • Автоперезапуск партии с обратным отсчётом

    Профиль иук

    • Псевдоним (принудительный при первом входе), счёт с анимацией накрутки, всплывающие +100 / −30, статистика побед/поражений/ничьих по режимам — всё в localStorage
    • Полностью процедурный звук на Web Audio API: SFX и генеративная фоновая музыка для каждой из 5 тем, слайдер громкости, кнопка музыки, полноэкранный режим, горячая клавиша R

    Проект собран успешно — dist/index.html готов к публикации.

    Проект развернут

} b[i] = ''; if (threats > 0) threatBlocks.push({ i, threats }); } if (threatBlocks.length) { threatBlocks.sort((a, b2) => b2.threats - a.threats); return threatBlocks[0].i; } } let bestScore = -Infinity, bestMoves = []; for (const i of empty) { let score = scoreCell(b, i, AI, conf) * 2.0 + scoreCell(b, i, HUMAN, conf) * 1.1 + centerBias(i, n) * 0.3; if (conf.ai === 'hard') score += Math.random() * 0.15; else score += Math.random() * 1.2; if (score > bestScore + 1e-9) { bestScore = score; bestMoves = [i]; } else if (Math.abs(score - bestScore) < 1e-9) bestMoves.push(i); } return bestMoves[Math.floor(Math.random() * bestMoves.length)]; } function scoreCell(b, idx, player, conf) { const n = conf.size, need = conf.winLen, r = Math.floor(idx / n), c = idx % n, dirs = [[1,0],[0,1],[1,1],[1,-1]]; let total = 0; for (const [dc, dr] of dirs) { for (let offset = 0; offset < need; offset++) { let own = 0, opp = 0, valid = true; for (let k = 0; k < need; k++) { const rr = r + dr*(k - offset), cc = c + dc*(k - offset); if (rr < 0 || rr >= n || cc < 0 || cc >= n) { valid = false; break; } const v = b[rr*n + cc]; if (v === player) own++; else if (v !== '') opp++; } if (!valid) continue; if (opp === 0) { if (own === need - 1) total += 1000; else if (own === need - 2) total += 100; else if (own === need - 3) total += 10; else total += 1; total += own * 2; } } } return total; } function centerBias(idx, n) { const r = Math.floor(idx / n), c = idx % n, mid = (n - 1) / 2, d = Math.abs(r - mid) + Math.abs(c - mid); return Math.max(0, n - d); } modeSwitchBtns.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ensureAudio(); SFX.switch(); setGameMode(btn.dataset.mode); })); diffBtns.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => setMode(btn.dataset.mode))); restartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { ensureAudio(); SFX.click(); init(); }); musicBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { ensureAudio(); musicEnabled = !musicEnabled; musicBtn.textContent = musicEnabled ? '🔊' : '🔇'; if (musicEnabled) Music.resume(); else Music.stop(); }); volumeSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => { ensureAudio(); const v = parseInt(e.target.value, 10) / 100; setMasterVolume(v); volumeLabel.textContent = e.target.value + '%'; }); setMasterVolume(volumeSlider.value / 100); volumeLabel.textContent = volumeSlider.value + '%'; loadProfile(); refreshProfileUI(); if (!profile.nick || profile.nick === 'Гость') { openNickModal(true); } // Инициализация онлайн-модала const onlineModal = document.getElementById('onlineModal'); const createRoomBtn = document.getElementById('createRoomBtn'); const joinRoomBtn = document.getElementById('joinRoomBtn'); const roomCodeInput = document.getElementById('roomCodeInput'); const roomInfo = document.getElementById('roomInfo'); const closeOnlineBtn = document.getElementById('closeOnlineBtn'); closeOnlineBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { onlineModal.style.display = 'none'; if (onlineUnsubscribe) { onlineUnsubscribe(); onlineUnsubscribe = null; } }); createRoomBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => { ensureAudio(); try { if (!firebase.auth().currentUser) { await firebase.auth().signInAnonymously(); } const gameId = 'room_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase(); const db = firebase.database(); const gameRef = db.ref('games/' + gameId); await gameRef.set({ board: Array(9).fill(''), turn: 'X', status: 'waiting', createdAt: Date.now() }); onlineGameId = gameId; onlinePlayerSymbol = 'X'; onlineBoardTurn = 'X'; roomInfo.textContent = 'Комната создана! Код: ' + gameId + ' (Ожидание друга...)'; roomInfo.style.color = '#7dffa8'; subscribeToGame(gameId); } catch (e) { console.error(e); roomInfo.textContent = 'Ошибка: ' + e.message; roomInfo.style.color = '#ff8a8a'; } }); joinRoomBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => { ensureAudio(); const code = roomCodeInput.value.trim().toUpperCase(); if (!code) return; try { if (!firebase.auth().currentUser) { await firebase.auth().signInAnonymously(); } const db = firebase.database(); const gameRef = db.ref('games/' + code); const snapshot = await gameRef.once('value'); if (!snapshot.exists()) { roomInfo.textContent = 'Комната не найдена!'; roomInfo.style.color = '#ff8a8a'; return; } onlineGameId = code; onlinePlayerSymbol = 'O'; roomInfo.textContent = 'Вы вошли в комнату ' + code; roomInfo.style.color = '#7dffa8'; await gameRef.update({ status: 'playing' }); subscribeToGame(code); } catch (e) { console.error(e); roomInfo.textContent = 'Ошибка: ' + e.message; roomInfo.style.color = '#ff8a8a'; } }); function subscribeToGame(gameId) { if (onlineUnsubscribe) onlineUnsubscribe(); const db = firebase.database(); const gameRef = db.ref('games/' + gameId); onlineUnsubscribe = gameRef.on('value', (snapshot) => { const data = snapshot.val(); if (!data) return; if (data.status === 'playing' && onlineModal.style.display === 'flex') { onlineModal.style.display = 'none'; setMode('online'); } if (data.board) { board = data.board; onlineBoardTurn = data.turn; render(); const winRes = getWinLine(board); if (winRes) { gameOver = true; highlight(winRes.line); if (winRes.player === onlinePlayerSymbol) { statusEl.textContent = 'Вы победили! 🎉'; statusEl.style.color = '#7dffa8'; SFX.win(); addScore(100); } else { statusEl.textContent = 'Вы проиграли! 😢'; statusEl.style.color = '#ff8a8a'; SFX.lose(); addScore(-30); } return; } if (board.every(v => v !== '')) { gameOver = true; statusEl.textContent = 'Ничья 🤝'; statusEl.style.color = '#ffd97d'; SFX.draw(); return; } if (!gameOver) { setTurnStatus(); } } }); } setMode('easy'); document.addEventListener('click', () => { ensureAudio(); if (musicEnabled && !Music.timer) Music.resume(); }, { once: true }); fullscreenBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { ensureAudio(); SFX.click(); if (!document.fullscreenElement) { document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(err => { console.log(`Ошибка при попытке включить полноэкранный режим: ${err.message}`); }); } else { if (document.exitFullscreen) { document.exitFullscreen(); } } }); document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => { if (document.fullscreenElement) { fullscreenBtn.textContent = '⛶'; fullscreenBtn.style.opacity = '0.7'; } else { fullscreenBtn.textContent = '⛶'; fullscreenBtn.style.opacity = '1'; } }); </script></body> </html>
